description: This Java class defines the ExternalAssetOwnerTransferDetails entity, which models details related to external asset owner transfers within the Fineract investor module. It includes fields for various financial metrics such as outstanding amounts, overpaid amounts, and relations to an external asset owner transfer. The class provides setters with logic to keep the total outstanding amounts updated.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnerTransferDetails
classes.description: Entity class representing transfer details of external asset owners, extending auditable entities for tracking creation and modification times.

methods.name: setTotalPrincipalOutstanding
methods.description: Sets the total principal outstanding amount and updates the overall total outstanding.

methods.name: setTotalInterestOutstanding
methods.description: Sets the total interest outstanding amount and updates the overall total outstanding.

methods.name: setTotalFeeChargesOutstanding
methods.description: Sets the total fee charges outstanding amount and updates the overall total outstanding.

methods.name: setTotalPenaltyChargesOutstanding
methods.description: Sets the total penalty charges outstanding amount and updates the overall total outstanding.

methods.name: updateTotalOutstanding
methods.description: Recalculates the total outstanding amount by summing principal, interest, fee charges, and penalty charges.
